description: Sundaram Multi Pap Limited designs, manufactures, and markets paper stationery products for students in India. It operates through Paper Stationery and Digital Education segments. The company offers notebook, A4 case bound and book, original long book, graph book, scrap book, educational paper stationery, practical paper, tinted paper, pocket note book, sketch book, origami paper, case bound book, cash memo, big long book, triplicate book, voucher book, rent receipt, king A5 Note Book, drawing book, laboratory book, lekhan book, subject book, project book, graph paper, drawing paper, wiro note book, perfect binding book, C-ruled register, duplicate book, delivery challan book, scribbling pad, and conference pad. It also provides office and corporate stationery products, as well as printing, writing, and packaging paper products. In addition, the company offers E-CLASS, an educational content for the students of Maharashtra State Board's 1st to 10th standards for various subjects available in English, Marathi, Semi English, Hindi, and Urdu medium as per the syllabus. It sells its products under the Sundaram brand. Sundaram Multi Pap Limited was founded in 1985 and is based in Palghar, India.
